headline: 505 Riverside Avenue hazard mitigation grant and planning for post-demolition and site re-naturalization, plus miscellaneous updates.
summary: Discussion of the 505 Riverside Avenue hazard mitigation grant and planning for post-demolition and site re-naturalization. Updates include a revised specimen tree map, vegetation ordinance status, wetlands amendment, Urban Reserve in the Comprehensive Plan, and a March 2027 follow-up stakeholder summit.
